weakness: The hosted braid workflow failed without step-level evidence, while prior build changes assumed the job reached checkout, dependency installation, or validator execution.
hypothesis: A shell-only hosted-runner probe executed before marketplace actions will classify whether the failure boundary occurs before or after runner and shell startup, reducing speculative implementation edits.
evaluation_window: next terminal run of the Braid Control Plane workflow
adoption_gate: The runner probe reaches a terminal conclusion on the exact PR head
A passing probe includes the runner-shell-started marker or phase summary
A failing probe is not attributed to validator or dependency behavior
The result selects exactly one next diagnostic boundary
risks: A passing shell probe does not prove marketplace actions are permitted
GitHub UI or connector limitations may still hide step summaries
The probe adds one short hosted job per relevant revision
rollback: Remove the runner-probe job and the validate-braid needs dependency; retain this experiment and terminal run evidence as decision history.
